lines.en: I knock on the door and wait for Sana to answer.
She mentioned at the bar recently (And rather bluntly, if I do remember correctly) that she’s definitely been getting a little jealous of how often the people she's close to bring me up.
She also mentioned that she wants to learn karate, but I’m pretty sure that wasn’t true.
There is no way I can picture Sana doing karate, even if I close my eyes and rid myself of everything else.
Either way, spending more time alone with her is sure to help her feel a little better about our dynamic.
And, who knows?
Maybe we’ll wind up taking another huge step today?
: SENSEEEEIIIIIII! I KNOW YOUR KNOOOOOOOCK!!!!!!
Or maybe Ayane is here and that won’t happen at all.
: COME ON IN AND *hic* HANG OUT WITH USSSSSSSSS!!!!!
: Ayane...you don’t have to yell...Sensei is-
: Sensei!! The door is open!!
: Come inside!
: HEH. YEAH SENSEI! COME INSIDE.
And apparently Sara is here as well.
It appears that my plan to hang out with Sana away from the prying eyes of her best friend and her mother has...failed in the most dramatic way possible.
Also, they’re definitely drunk right now.
I’m going in.
I push the door open to be immediately assaulted by the scent of white wine and perfume.
So basically it just smells like Sara’s room.
And that’s okay. It’s not a particularly bad combination of scents, it just...
Well, it’s not something this room normally smells like.
: Um...hi, Sensei...
: You picked a...pretty bad night to come here...
: I think he picked the best night to come here.
: Yeah. The best night to come here.
: Are you going to pronounce that word the same way all night?
: Don’t question her, Sensei. That’s the best way to pronounce it.
: Sara, aren’t you a little too old to be in here?
: Aren’t you a little too male to be in here? This is my daughter’s room, you know.
: If you were looking for mine, you’re a couple miles off.
: Did you...um...
: Did you need something, Sensei?
: Course he doesn’t *hic* need anything, Sana.
: He’s here to look at our pajamas and give us lots of hugs and tell us how *hic* pretty we are.
: Oh. Well, if that’s the case, it’s fine that you’re here.
: You’d be...fine with me coming here to hug your daughter and tell her how pretty she is?
: As long as you do the same for me, sure.
: Besides, we all know who has the best pajamas here.
: Dass right...Me.
: Obviously, I’m talking about myself.
: I’ll accept my first hug and compliment now.
: I’m sorry I’m not dressed as...
: Well...that I’m not dressed like them.
: You’re dressed how you’re always dressed for bed.
: Sensei! Tell *hic* Sana that she should shed some layers!
: Sara and me are showing some skin and Sana looks like she’s ready for a trip to Antarctica.
: I’d need...a few more layers for Antarctica...
: And also...I’m not really comfortable...showing that much of my skin.
: But you’re a spitting image of me and I’m an attractive, totally youthful woman who has yet to pass the age where it’s okay for me to hang out here.
: I really...rather you wouldn’t, though...
: If *hic* Sara wasn’t here then how would we get the wine?
: We wouldn’t because we’re...you know...
: I didn’t even know you drank, Ayane.
: Course I *hic* do. Jusssss...not often...
: But this tastes like the kinda stuff Ami and I snuck out of your liquor cabinet a billion years ago that you never found out about. Remember?
: How would I remember something I never found out about?
: Idunno. Figure it out, [ayanemaster].
: Uhh...anywho-
: Wanna tell my daughter here to loosen up a little bit?
: She seems to look up to you and she won’t take off her clothes or drink tonight.
: Mom!
: I swear, it’s like she’s not even my daughter sometimes.
: I...I say weird things when I get drunk!
: I don’t want to wind up...doing something that will make the two of you mad...
: Mhm, mhm. But that still doesn’t explain you being all bundled up. You don’t fit in.
: We’re all about body positivity in this dorm, Sana-dear.
: Don’t...make up dorm rules when you...don’t even live here.
: You know I...feel weird when I’m not covered up...
: She’s embarrassed because she doesn’t wear a big girl bra yet.
: Mom! Why are you even here?!
: Leave!
: Sensei doesn’t want to hear that!
: What do you *hic* mean he doesn’t wanna hear that? Sensei’s a major hot dog.
: I think you mean horn dog, Ayane.
: No way. The hot dog’s the *hic* wiener lookin’ one, right? Dass what you are.
: Just a big ole raw hot dog walkin’ all over the place like you *hic* think you’re all that.
: Well *hic* I’ve got one thing to tell ya, buddy.
: You are all that and I love you very much.
: Gonna *hic* stop talking now. Drank *hic* too much.
: Are you...trying to make me feel bad?...
: Of course not, dear. I’m just playing with you.
: If you really want me to leave, I’ll leave.
: Okay...then...leave.
: Oh. That backfired.
: I didn’t think you were going to actually ask me to leave.
: I don’t want to...but...I don’t want you to make me feel...immature.
: I...I live on my own now...
: And if I...want to stay covered up...I can stay covered up...
: R...Right, Sensei?
What?
Why am I suddenly the deciding factor in this?
: Tell my...mom that...you’re just here to...talk to us and not...s...strip us.
: And also...forget the...b...bra thing that you just heard...
Unfortunately, I’m not sure if I can successfully do either of those two things.
Sana does have a point, though.
She’s already been feeling uneasy about how much time I spend with the other two.
And it probably makes her feel even more inferior with them sitting around half-naked, drinking wine while she’s bundled up in a giant hoodie with a soda.
: I just wanted to see what you guys were up to.
: And Ayane’s asleep so it’s probably safe for me to say this now, but I wanted to hang out with you tonight, Sana.
: And no, that doesn’t involve stripping.
Unless you want it to.
Which you don’t, sadly.
: Wh...what?...
: You didn’t have to...say that...
: It’s okay if you came to see Ayane...I...I understand...
: He’s telling the truth.
: I know that look.
: And as jealous as I am that he didn’t just call me instead, I think I understand.
I sure hope she doesn’t actually understand.
: Obviously, he’s a man, so it’s in his nature to want to protect something.
: And since I’m such an independent, strong woman, he turned to the version of me who has yet to fully bloom since it’s the closest he could come.
Oh, good. She doesn’t get it.
That level of denial gives me serious Ami vibes, though.
Maybe I should worry about Sara?
: Well...umm...whatever the reason...
: It makes me really glad...hearing that you came here for me...Sensei...
: Even if you’re just saying that...because Ayane is asleep...
I’m really not. I can’t help but understand why Sana would think that, though.
And even though her mother was wrong in the end, she did raise a good point.
Maybe I do have some inherent desire to protect Sana?
In fact, I absolutely do have something like that. And I’ve known it since I first walked into her bar.
But it’s hard to tell how much of that is the result of me simply knowing she needs protection.
Even now, surrounded by the three people she’s more familiar with than anyone else, she feels cornered.
Not only by people physically bigger than her (In a number of ways) but by people more emotionally mature and more confident.
She’s on the back foot in her very own element.
It’s just like how I used to feel insignificant when my-
: ...Sensei?
: Hey, are you okay?
: Your eyes suddenly got really wide out of nowhere.
: It wasn’t...out of nowhere...
: It was after how I mentioned...him coming for Ayane.
: But, I-
It’s suddenly harder to speak than it normally is.
My head hurts for some reason, but I’m not exactly able to pinpoint where.
It’s strange.
I feel like I was about to remember something.
But I guess it wasn’t important.
I can even hear my favorite song crawl back into my head and confirm this.
: A-Anyway!
: I...um...I talked to Ayane about maybe...coming to a karate class soon...
: But I’d...like for you to be there...too...
: Oh, you were actually serious about the karate thing?
: Karate thing? What karate thing?
: My little Sana’s not thinking about learning a martial art, is she?
: Her bones will snap like twigs.
: That’s...that’s why I need Sensei to be there...
: Because he’ll step in if someone...attacks me...
: I think you’re misinterpreting how karate lessons normally go.
: I don’t know...your...karate instructor got really loud...by the end of the night...
: She seems kind of scary...
: The actual scary one was the woman next to her. I’m pretty sure she’s a serial killer.
: Karate instructor? Serial killer?
: Did we actually have customers the other night?
: Did you not notice a huge increase in sales? The serial killer drank like half of your stock.
: Oh! So that’s where all that money came from!
: I don’t care if she was a serial killer! Get her to come back!
: Isn’t she just...a teacher?...
: If she was a serial killer, we’d...probably know...
: If we knew, she’d be a horrible serial killer.
: I...just think she’s...an alcoholic...
: So am I but I’ve never stooped to killing anyone.
: Is my daughter really going to be doing karate with a serial killer?
: Not a serial killer. The person next to the serial killer.
: Oh. Well, that sounds a lot safer.
: But umm...anyway...you’ll protect me...right, Sensei?...
: There’s not really anything to protect you from unless you’re planning on joining some fight club, but sure.
: Maybe...I am?...
: What if I’m a really...strong fighter?
: Like...Zagull Throat Spear or...Stone Cold Steve Austin?...
: I don’t know who either of those people are.
: Isn’t Stone Cold Steve Austin that one wrestler you used to watch on TV with-
My favorite song turns off again.
Today is bad.
: Did you remember something?...
It's good knowing that today is bad for other people, too.
: Want to go for a walk?
: Mhm...
: Okay...
Sana and Sara leave without acknowledging me, and I don’t blame them.
But I’m now faced with an empty head and an inebriated [high_school]er- two things that could mix horribly if I’d truly given up on everything.
Thankfully, I’m an outstanding citizen.
A man with a moral compass that matches the size of his cock.
And I can put this girl to bed without defiling her.
: Sensei...
: Oh. You’re awake.
: I was never really asleep.
: Are Sana and her mom going to be okay?
: I don’t know.
: I see.
: My head really hurts.
: How much did you drink?
: Two glasses.
: Lightweight, huh?
: Shut up...you know I don’t normally drink...
: I know, I know.
: Can you help me to the bed?
: You mean the bed that’s right behind you?
: Or yours. Either one works for meeee~
Something resembling a smile finds its way onto my face as Ayane trails off into a fit of childish laughter.
: Let’s put you to bed.
: Thank you...[ayanemaster]...
Ayane doesn’t take long to pass out.
The second her head hits the pillow, her eyes close and I’m suddenly alone again.
I wait around for a little while to see if Sana and Sara come back.
But I give up after twenty minutes of sitting awkwardly on the floor waiting for anything to happen.
Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!
